title: Plan to visit us at #JEC2022!
description: We're preparing to pack our bags and attend the first JEC Trade Show in over two years ! We're excited to be presenting at the USA Onstage Event and participating in other events during the show to network and connect with all of you.
excerpt: We’re preparing to pack our bags and attend the first JEC Trade Show in over two years ! We’re excited to be presenting at the “USA Onstage Event” and participating in other events during the show to network and connect with all of you. Come visit us at Booth R31C in Hall 6!
html:
We’re preparing to pack our bags and attend the first JEC Trade Show in over two years ! We’re excited to be presenting at the “USA Onstage Event” and participating in other events during the show to network and connect with all of you.

Come visit us at Booth R31C in Hall 6!
